ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Balmer Lawrie Investments Ltd. has confirmed compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) of the Depositories and Participants Regulations, 2018, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India Private Limited, certified that all securities received for dematerialization were processed correctly, including confirmation to depositories, listing on stock exchanges, and timely updates to the register of members. The document indicates routine regulatory adherence and no material red flags or adverse impacts.
